description: The bar chart illustrates the performance of different LLaMA-2 models—LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B—on the CoLeG-E benchmark, measured as a percentage, under four distinct training conditions: no Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), SFT only on $D_0$, SFT on both $D_0$ and $D_1$, and SFT on $D_0$, $D_1$, and $D_2$. The vertical axis represents the CoLeG-E (%) score, ranging from 0 to 50, while the horizontal axis lists the model sizes. For each model, four bars are shown, corresponding to the four training conditions, with distinct patterns and colors as indicated in the legend. For the LLaMA-2-7B model, the performance increases from approximately 5% with no SFT to about 30% with SFT on $D_0$, $D_1$, and $D_2$. For LLaMA-2-13B, the performance ranges from roughly 10% to 40%, and for LLaMA-2-70B, it ranges from about 28% to over 50%. Across all models, performance consistently improves with the addition of more SFT data, and larger models generally achieve higher scores, with the LLaMA-2-70B model showing the highest performance in all SFT conditions.
